Automatically resolves or creates the customer record by name, saves the ticket as CONFIRMED, creates a CHARGE transaction for the debt, and updates the customer balance. service_fee.description: Agent profit margin (phí dịch vụ). selling_price = net_price + service_fee. Defaults to 0.

selling_price.title: Selling Price
selling_price.description: Final price charged to the customer (giá bán). If omitted, computed as net_price + service_fee. If provided, must equal net_price + service_fee.

discount.title: Discount
discount.description: Optional discount amount applied to the ticket in VND.

TicketConfirmPayload.title: TicketConfirmPayload
TicketConfirmPayload.description:
Payload sent by the frontend when the user confirms an AI-parsed ticket.

Customer identification:
    The user can identify the customer by name (and optionally `customer_type`).
    The service will look up an existing customer by name (case-insensitive) or
    create a new one if no match is found.

Pricing (docs/BUSINESS.md §2):
    selling_price = net_price + service_fee
    If `selling_price` is omitted, the service derives it automatically.
    If both `service_fee` and `selling_price` are supplied they must be consistent.

pnr.title: Pnr
pnr.description: 6-character PNR (Passenger Name Record) booking reference code. May repeat across passenger rows in group bookings.

airline.description: Carrier code: VNA (Vietnam Airlines), VJ (Vietjet), QH (Bamboo), VU (Vietravel).

ticket_number.title: Ticket Number
ticket_number.description: Airline ticket number. May repeat across outbound/return ticket rows.

fare_class.title: Fare Class
fare_class.description: Optional fare class / fare family label from the source ticket, e.g. B or Flexible.

departure_place.title: Departure Place
departure_place.description: Human-readable departure place, e.g. Da Nang City.

arrival_place.title: Arrival Place
arrival_place.description: Human-readable arrival place, e.g. Ho Chi Minh City.

departure_code.title: Departure Code

arrival_code.title: Arrival Code

flight_date.title: Flight Date

net_price.title: Net Price

selling_price.title: Selling Price
selling_price.description: Selling price charged to the customer (giá bán). Must be ≥ 0.

discount.description: Optional discount amount applied to the ticket in VND.
